description: Create an annotation event with a given category, title and description. Optionally start, end or durations can be provided.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds of annotation. Default: 0

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Unix timestamp of event start. If not specified, it defaults to “now”.

parameters.name: stop
parameters.description: Unix timestamp of event end. If not specified, it defaults to “now” + duration.

examples:
- name: Create a simple annotation event with a source, defaults to start and end time of now
  community.general.circonus_annotation:
    api_key: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
    title: App Config Change
    description: This is a detailed description of the config change
    category: This category groups like annotations

- name: Create an annotation with a duration of 5 minutes and a default start time of now
  community.general.circonus_annotation:
    api_key: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
    title: App Config Change
    description: This is a detailed description of the config change
    category: This category groups like annotations
    duration: 300

- name: Create an annotation with a start_time and end_time
  community.general.circonus_annotation:
    api_key: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
    title: App Config Change
    description: This is a detailed description of the config change
    category: This category groups like annotations
    start_time: 1395940006
    end_time: 1395954407

return_values.name: annotation
return_values.description: Details about the created annotation. Returned: success

return_values.name: _last_modified
return_values.description: Last modification timestamp. Returned: success Sample: 1502236928

return_values.name: _last_modified_by
return_values.description: Last modified by. Returned: success Sample: "/user/1000"

return_values.name: category
return_values.description: Category of the created annotation. Returned: success Sample: "alerts"

return_values.name: description
return_values.description: Description of the created annotation. Returned: success Sample: "Host is down."

return_values.name: rel_metrics
return_values.description: Array of metrics related to this annotation, each metrics is a string. Returned: success Sample: ["54321_kbps"]

return_values.name: start
return_values.description: Timestamp, since annotation applies. Returned: success Sample: "Host is down."

return_values.name: stop
return_values.description: Timestamp, since annotation ends. Returned: success Sample: "Host is down."

return_values.name: title
return_values.description: Title of the created annotation. Returned: success Sample: "WARNING"
